title: SSL/TLS Certificates: Reissue, Duplicate and Revocation Terms
content:
**Schedule to the SSL/TLS Certificates service terms — reissues, duplicates, revocation and key types.** The figures and terms below apply to every Harborline certificate product for the life of a subscription.

## Part 1 — Reissues and duplicates

| Certificate product | Fee per reissue within the subscription (USD) | Largest number of reissues per certificate in a trailing 30 days | Days before the current certificate's expiry on which the next certificate is issued automatically, where validation can complete automatically | Extra copies of the same certificate for other servers at no charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline DV Single Domain | 0.00 | 20 | 30 | Yes |
| Harborline DV Multi-Domain | 0.00 | 20 | 30 | Yes |
| Harborline DV Wildcard | 0.00 | 20 | 30 | Yes |
| Harborline OV Single Domain | 0.00 | 20 | 30 | Yes |
| Harborline OV Wildcard | 0.00 | 20 | 30 | Yes |
| Harborline EV Single Domain | 0.00 | 20 | 30 | Yes |
| Harborline EV Multi-Domain | 0.00 | 20 | 30 | Yes |

## Part 2 — Revocation and transparency

| Certificate product | Fee to revoke a certificate (USD) | A certificate revoked for key compromise is replaced by a free reissue within the same subscription | Certificates logged to public Certificate Transparency logs |
|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline DV Single Domain | 0.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Harborline DV Multi-Domain | 0.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Harborline DV Wildcard | 0.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Harborline OV Single Domain | 0.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Harborline OV Wildcard | 0.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Harborline EV Single Domain | 0.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Harborline EV Multi-Domain | 0.00 | Yes | Yes |

## Part 3 — Key types accepted in a certificate request (every product)

RSA 2048-bit, RSA 3072-bit, RSA 4096-bit, ECDSA P-256 and ECDSA P-384.

## Notes on the schedule

1. A reissue costs 0.00 under every product, and the count of reissues of one certificate in any trailing 30 days may reach 20.
2. The automatic issue of the next certificate 30 days before the current one expires is tied to validation that can complete automatically.
3. Revocation carries a fee of 0.00 under every product, and a certificate revoked because its private key was compromised is replaced by a free reissue while the subscription continues.
4. A duplicate, an extra copy of the same certificate for another server, is issued at no charge under every product.
